title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #20

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which verse commands wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 5:6
   B. Qur'an 110:3
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 1:2

2. Which posture is closest to Allah, according to the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Sujud
   B. Taslim
   C. Ruku
   D. Qiyam

3. What was he called before prophethood? (1 mark)
   A. As-Siddiq
   B. Al-Farooq
   C. Al-Haqq
   D. Al-Amin

4. Which of these is NOT the correct way to treat a prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Worshipping the prophet
   B. Loving him
   C. Respecting him
   D. Following his good example

5. What does "Ar-Rahim" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Source of Peace
   B. The All-Hearing
   C. The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers
   D. The Owner of the Day

6. Why is wudhu important? (1 mark)
   A. It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   B. It is a game
   C. It makes prayer shorter
   D. It replaces prayer

7. Why must clothes and the prayer place be clean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a game
   B. It is not needed
   C. It saves money
   D. Purity is a condition of prayer

8. What does "Qul a'udhu" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Say: I seek refuge
   B. Say: I forgive
   C. Say: I worship
   D. Say: I thank

9. What is obedience? (1 mark)
   A. Running away
   B. Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good
   C. Ignoring orders
   D. Arguing

10. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do before sleeping according to Aisha (R.A.)? (1 mark)
   A. Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   B. Recited only Al-Fatiha standing
   C. Recited Al-Masad three times
   D. Slept without any remembrance

11. How often should a toothbrush be replaced? (1 mark)
   A. About every three months or when bristles bend
   B. Every ten years
   C. Every day
   D. Never

12. Which companion stayed with the Prophet in the cave of Thawr? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Zayd
   D. Ali

13. Ar-Rahman's mercy is (1 mark)
   A. Only for the rich
   B. For all creation
   C. Only for Muslims in Kenya
   D. Only for adults

14. Which is a positive use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Bullying online
   B. Sharing rumours
   C. Watching harmful content
   D. Learning a surah with a recording

15. Which is a wrong belief about angels? (1 mark)
   A. That they are made of light
   B. That they obey Allah
   C. That they carry out duties
   D. That they are Allah's daughters

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how each of the six names studied should change our behaviour. (5 marks)

17. What happened to the woman who did not feed her cat? (3 marks)

18. Explain how Prophet Yusuf (A.S.) showed honesty and truthfulness. (3 marks)

19. Explain why the Prophet (S.A.W.) is called Al-Amin and how a child can be trustworthy. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Qur'an 5:6
   Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6.

2. A — Sujud
   A servant is closest in sujud.

3. D — Al-Amin
   Al-Amin means the trustworthy.

4. A — Worshipping the prophet
   We worship Allah alone.

5. C — The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers
   Ar-Rahim is Allah's special mercy.

6. A — It is needed for the prayer to be valid
   Prayer is not accepted without it.

7. D — Purity is a condition of prayer
   A valid prayer needs purity.

8. A — Say: I seek refuge
   Both protection surahs begin with these words.

9. B — Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good
   Obedience is following good commands.

10. A — Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   This is reported in Al-Bukhari.

11. A — About every three months or when bristles bend
   Worn bristles do not clean well.

12. B — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was his companion.

13. B — For all creation
   It covers believers and non-believers, people and animals.

14. D — Learning a surah with a recording
   Media can teach.

15. D — That they are Allah's daughters
   Islam rejects this.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: be merciful to all; Ar-Rahim: forgive others; Al-Malik: use things well; As-Salam: bring peace; As-Sami': make dua and speak well; Al-Basir: be honest in private.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name with matching behaviour up to 5.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: She tied the cat and did not feed it or let it find food. She was punished because of this. It teaches us that cruelty to animals is a sin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for the punishment, 1 mark for the lesson.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to do wrong when tempted, he feared Allah, and stayed honest even in prison. The Qur'an calls him Siddiq.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusing wrong, 1 mark for honesty in hardship, 1 mark for Siddiq.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: The people of Makkah trusted him with their valuables because he was honest. A child can keep promises, return borrowed items, and keep secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for two ways.
